name: Kunshan Huguang Auto Harness Co.,Ltd.
summary: Kunshan Huguang Auto Harness Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of wiring harnesses for passenger vehicles in China. The company offers complete wiring harnesses, engine wiring harnesses, other wiring harnesses, customized wiring harnesses for complete vehicles, high-voltage wiring harnesses for new energy vehicles, battery pack wiring harnesses, engine wiring harnesses, instrument panel wiring harnesses, body wiring harnesses, door wiring harnesses, headliner wiring harnesses, and rear wiring harnesses.
